body: Absolutely Love These Tiles — A Total Hit at Our Studio! I absolutely love the Lucky Daughter Auntie Set! From the beautiful colors to the thoughtful meaning behind the design, these tiles are truly something special. They are fun, unique, and definitely make a statement on the mahjong table! There are a couple of things I’ve noticed that I don’t necessarily love. The backs of the tiles seem to show smudges and fingerprints constantly, which can be a little frustrating. Also, some players have a hard time distinguishing the cups as cracks rather than dots, although that personally doesn’t bother me. As the owner of a mahjong studio, I get to see firsthand how different players react to different tile sets, and let me tell you, these have been a total hit! Despite those couple of minor drawbacks, I wouldn’t dream of taking them out of our studio rotation. They are just too beautiful and fun to play with! I’m now anxiously awaiting the matching mat and the holiday set to arrive! Clearly, I’m a fan, and I can’t wait to add more Lucky Daughter to our tables!

body: Ladies, I had to hold back tears when I received this set. I saw my childhood flash before my eyes and every wonderful Christmas memory I ever had came flooding back. The ornaments were the initial thing that drew me to this set because they remind me of the shiny bright ornaments I live so much. But every single ornament and present on the cracks is different! How did you even manage that My favorite tile is the joker snow globe. All the things that I grew up with at Christmas, the letters to Santa, the stockings…are right here for me to reminisce over every time I play. Some friends and I turned on the Christmas music and played until midnight and we just couldn’t think anymore. It was a wonderful night full of fun with your beautiful creation! Thank you so much for the memories you brought back!

body: I've played on quite a few mats, and the Osmanthus Grove Mahjong Mat from Mahjong Row & Co. has quickly become one of my favorites. The first thing that stood out to me was the depth and richness of the color. The earthy green tones are beautiful without being overwhelming, and they create an elegant backdrop that lets the tiles shine. One of the things I appreciate most is how versatile this mat is. I've paired it with several different tile sets and racks, and it complements every combination beautifully. Whether I'm using a bold, colorful set or something more classic, this mat seems to pull the whole table together. The mat was intentionally designed to coordinate with a variety of standard American Mah Jong accessories, and it really shows. Beyond the aesthetics, the quality is outstanding. It lays flat, the tiles shuffle smoothly, and it has the premium feel you'd expect from a mat you'll use again and again. The included drawstring storage bag is also a thoughtful touch for transporting and storing it between games. If you're looking for a mat that's both beautiful and functional, I would absolutely recommend the Osmanthus Grove Mahjong Mat. It's become a staple at my table, and I know it'll be in my rotation for years to come.

body: Features & What Stands Out •	Progressive Learning Levels: The game introduces three levels—Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced—each increasing in complexity, so kids can move at their own pace. ￼ •	Kid-Friendly Design: Components include colorful tiles, a combination card, easy-to-follow instructional guides, and accessories designed with little hands and curious minds in mind. ￼ •	Family Engagement: Unlike many children’s games, Mini Mahjer encourages children to play alongside adults using the standard National Mahjong League (NMJL) card—bridging generations and making it a family bonding experience. ￼ •	Portable and Durable: The card is printed on sturdy cardstock and compact enough for travel, classrooms, or playdates. This tile set is so true to the brand’s punchline, “Delivering Smiles.” It radiates joy and is so true to my personality—happy, colorful, and upbeat! But honestly, nothing compares to the joy their customer service has brought me. Multiple emails a day, prompt and honest responses-even on weekends sometimes! Not a single inquiry went unanswered. They were always willing to troubleshoot and help, and they did so with such a generous and kind approach. I truly couldn’t have picked a better company for my first-ever Mahjong tile purchase & I know I'll be coming back for more! title: Pure Happiness
body: As a relative newcomer to the world of mahjong, I found MFM online and instantly fell in love with the Florida tile set - I had to have it. As a native Floridian now living in the Northeast, I am continually homesick for the Sunshine State. MFM's tile set perfectly captures the sunny, playful nature of Florida - from the beautiful colors to the alligator dragons to the flamingo one bam.  Everything is super cute. When my tile set came, I thought it was so gorgeous and well-made that of course (!) I had to buy a set of acrylic racks & pushers to match and a velvet bag to store the racks & pushers and a tote bag to store it all [if you give a mahj mom a tile set ...].  Every single piece is so beautifully crafted and frankly just makes me smile - a little bit of sunshine in every game.  I look forward to playing with my set every week.  On top of all of this, the customer service is EXCELLENT - items ship and arrive lightning fast, everything is packaged securely and beautifully and when I thought I was missing two pushers from my delivery (100% user error) they were quick to respond and very helpful.  Thank you MFM, you have a customer for life!!!

Each inner box comes with a soft hi-grade lining to protect everything. FYI, I also liked the Toucan tile backs but didn't want a soft case. A friend was impressed with the Butterfly backs. title: Staunton European Chess Set
body: I like the chess set for the money nice and not to fancy. Good quality board and nice compartment to hold each chess piece. However, in the shipping process the chess board was slightly damaged due to putting the chess board in a large longer box where it would slide around to each end when picked up. It should have been packed better so it wouldn't slide freely. The corner was slightly damaged but not enough for me to merit sending it back. A shame there wasn't better care in packing such a nice set for the money. Root cause is use a box the right size and pack it so it doesn't slide and get damaged.
author: James B.

title: Disappointed
body: Overall I was quite disappointed in the "overall" quality of the chessmen. They were also advertised to be "weighted" pieces, but if they were I could not tell it. The chessboard and inside storage were fine.
author: Milton H.

product_title: Traditional American Mahjong Set, "Sparrows" - Bone & Bamboo Tiles, Rosewood Case, Betting Sticks, Dice, & 4 Wind Tiles
title: The set is lovely
body: The set came and looks as expected. The box is quite lively and sits out in the game room as a work of beauty. All parts were included including both flower and worker flower tiles extra jokers, betting g sticks and dice. The rosewood racks purchased separately are lovely also. My magnets were set correctly so pushers work well.
author: Margaret Murray

product_title: Traditional American Mahjong Set, "Sparrows" - Bone & Bamboo Tiles, Rosewood Case, Betting Sticks, Dice, & 4 Wind Tiles

body: Easy ordering, quick delivery. I would def order again from Yellow Mountain.
author: Andrea G.

product_title: Traditional American Mahjong Set, "Sparrows" - Bone & Bamboo Tiles, Rosewood Case, Betting Sticks, Dice, & 4 Wind Tiles
title: Pretty good reproduction, but defective.
body: This set is similar to the wood boxes from the 1920s, except for the disappointing masonite back panel with holes to stick your fingers through to push open the drawers. The bamboo and bone tiles are handmade and nice. But my box has a deep crack in the wood, and one of the tiles has a distinctive stain that is visible while playing. I notified Yellow Mountain Imports of the problems about a week ago, but no answer from them yet, only an acknowledgment that they received my message.
author: Gilda B.

body: Quite elegant! I use it mostly for reproducing games from books and online. It has the perfect size board for this. It's also good for doing pick up games almost anywhere. Nice pieces too.

body: This chess set is very durable with strong magnets. It is not only great for travel but also for positional analysis. How do I know? I bought (2) of them.

product_title: Travel Magnetic Chess Set (9.8") - Folding and Portable Board Game
title: Nice Little Set
body: I purchased this set for travel play and for analysis with books and the computer at my desk. It is the perfect size for both. I ordered it online on the 13th of the month and it arrived on the 15th! The set arrived well packaged and in perfect condition. Excellent super fast service! I highly recommend buying from Yellow Mountain Imports.
author: Freddy

product_title: Travel Magnetic Chess Set (9.8") - Folding and Portable Board Game
title: Really beautiful and well balanced chessmen.
body: I am pleasantly surprised. Really beautiful Staunton-ish chessmen, generously sized in relation to the board. The magnet are neither too strong nor too weak and they add some nice weight. The basis is cushioned with slim felt pads. I don't give the 5 stars because the type of hinges in the board are clearly prone to break and will not endure much. But the chessmen are really nice, and the seller sent me everything really fast and well packed.
author: Eddie G

product_title: Travel Magnetic Chess Set (9.8") - Folding and Portable Board Game
title: I bought four more sets they worked very well
body: I bought two of these to use in my library. They worked so well that I bought 4 more sets. The magnet on each piece is not too strong to impede movement, but strong enough to keep piesces in place if the board is bumped. I like being able to put the pieces inside the case the board makes when it is folded up. I thought the price was very reasonable compared to other magnetic sets that had smaller boards.
author: Vulture

product_title: Travel Magnetic Chess Set (9.8") - Folding and Portable Board Game
title: Great deal!
body: We wanted to get an inexpensive chess set for our 10 year old to take places with her...one we wouldn't freak out about if she lost it, or pieces of it.This does the job!Looks much better than expected, magnets are strong. Great deal for the price... or even for a bit more. :-)
author: Elizabeth

product_title: Travel Size American Mahjong Set, “Celadon” - 166 Mini Melamine Tiles, Teal Green Case, Acrylic Racks, Dice & Wind Indicator
title: Adorable and functional
body: These are easy to read despite being so small. I am using them for Solo practice. It’s nice that they are so Portable. I wish the racks had a tilt to them. The tiles stand straight up and down in them, I would be even easier to read if they were tilted. But I love them just the same. I tried playing a real game with my mom, who is 89. She also had no trouble seeing the tiles.
author: Carin R.

product_title: Travel Size American Mahjong Set, “Celadon” - 166 Mini Melamine Tiles, Teal Green Case, Acrylic Racks, Dice & Wind Indicator
title: Mini Mahjong Set
body: I was looking for a small tile set for traveling, I sometimes play by myself. Other travel sets were just an increment smaller than the regular size ones and they weigh a lot. This mini set is perfect, all the regular characters, bam and dots each tile has a number on it, everything is exactly the same as my regular set but these are truly mini size and light to carry on any trip. I highly recommend this set.
author: RL
